headline: A 1947 film explains what *backs your dollar*
quote: Guaranteed by huge reserves of gold and silver
title: How a 1947 film explained money (and what changed in 1971)
caption: From "What Is Money?" (1947), a classroom film. Back then, US paper money was linked to gold.
context: Not anymore: in *1971* the US ended the dollar's link to gold.
comment: What do you think backs the dollar today? 👇
